services.name: deploy
services.description: Build and run web apps from git repos — Node, Go, Python, static sites. Auto-detects project type, builds, and serves on custom subdomains.

services.name: auth
services.description: User authentication — register, login, JWT tokens, Google OAuth, passwordless (OTP, magic link), API keys, org membership, role-based access.

services.name: db
services.description: Auto-generated REST API for database collections — CRUD operations with filter, sort, and pagination. SQLite or PostgreSQL backend.

services.name: storage
services.description: File storage with upload, download, and management. Appwrite-compatible API for client SDKs.

services.name: functions
services.description: Serverless JavaScript runtime — write and deploy JS functions triggered by HTTP or cron schedule. Includes fetch, db, and env bindings.

services.name: realtime
services.description: WebSocket-based real-time subscriptions — clients subscribe to collection changes and receive live updates.

services.name: messaging
services.description: Outbound messaging — email (SMTP), SMS, push notifications, and webhook/Telegram providers.

services.name: webhooks
services.description: Outbound webhook delivery — register webhook endpoints, deliver events with HMAC-SHA256 signatures, retry with backoff.

services.name: forge
services.description: Project management — issues, labels, kanban boards, and wiki for each project.

services.name: cici
services.description: CI/CD pipelines — build, test, and deploy workflows triggered by git pushes.

services.name: monitoring
services.description: Metrics, logs, alerts, and health checks — structured JSON logging, component status, and hardware monitoring.
